verdict.rationale: CodeRabbit documents multi-repo analysis that links related repositories to detect breaking changes, API mismatches, and dependency issues across repository boundaries during review. It also presents large diffs as logical cohorts and layers, with range-specific summaries and diagrams showing how changes fit together. Path instructions provide per-area guidance that suits a large codebase. Missing for 10: explicit monorepo-scale documentation (indexing or context limits for very large repos), detail on how linked-repo context is surfaced in review comments, and independent or hands-on corroboration of cross-repo review quality.
